title: General Olusegun Obasanjo's campaign is shifting its focus to the campuses in the western part of Nigeria, with overtures being received from different segments of the region indicating a change of heart. The Progressive Unity Forum, which initially supported the Alliance for Democracy, has now joined the People's Democratic Party (PDP) and assured the body of its support for Obasanjo. Plans are also underway to launch youth wings of the campaign on campuses and in local governments in the southwest. Additionally, there are signs of decampment from other parties, such as the National Centre Party of Nigeria (NCPN) and the United Nigeria Congress Party (UNCP), with former members joining the PDP.
